card.name: Tardive dyskinesia 'may develop' wording
card.fires_on: The verb 'develop' right after 'may' or 'can' in the tardive dyskinesia warning, just before 'in patients treated with antipsychotic'. Weaker on similar verbs like 'observed' in risk statements.

modes.label: Develop in TD warning
modes.description: The verb 'develop' after 'may' or 'can' in the tardive dyskinesia section for antipsychotics.
modes.example: Tardive dyskinesia, a syndrome consisting of potentially irreversible, involuntary, dyskinetic movements, may<< develop>> in patients treated with antipsychotic

modes.label: Observed in risk statement
modes.description: A verb like 'observed' in a sentence about when a drug-related risk appeared.
modes.example: The increased risk of suicidal thoughts or behavior with AEDs was<< observed>> as early as one week after starting drug

card.plain: It marks the verb in the standard warning that tardive dyskinesia may develop in patients on antipsychotics.
evidence: Tardive dyskinesia (TD), may<< develop>> in patients treated with antipsychotic
